Guides / Raids, Tower & events / Safari Zone

Safari Zone

The endgame area: daily steps, a weekly pool, Safari Balls, Tokens, the Dex and the Ladder.

Steps and tripsWhat lives thereCatchingSafari TokensSafari Ladder

The Safari Zone opens with all 8 badges, from the Islands tab. You walk it by yourself, with your Buddy and Safari Balls. Your team rests during a trip: no EXP, money or items from it.

Steps and trips

  • 600 steps a day, refilled at 00:00 UTC. One encounter is one step. Leaving early keeps the rest of that day's steps.
  • Longer Trips in the Safari Shop add 60 steps a level, up to 10 levels. Trail Mix carries unused steps over once.
  • Your first visit gives you 100 Safari Balls and 500 Safari Tokens. After that, balls come from the shop. Safari Balls only work here.

What lives there

Odds in the SafariCompared with the islands

Perfect IVs×2
Common / Uncommon / Rare / Legendary×0.5 / ×1 / ×1.5 / ×2
  • A new pool of 60 species every Monday: 20 common, 18 uncommon, 16 rare, 6 legendary. Each week has its own scene. Wishlist: star up to 6 species and the Safari tab shows a dot the week one comes up.
  • Golden Hour: once a day, special odds double for 30 steps.
  • Safari outbreaks every 3 hours, 2 at a time, and one costume outbreak a day. Rare costumes can also walk in by themselves. Event costumes only appear during their event. Odds events only count on the islands, so Safari odds stay the same during them.
  • Alphas turn up about 1 in 200 encounters.
  • Mirage is the Safari's own look: sunset colours in a heat haze, with Rising Heat in battle (+5% Speed a turn, up to +25%, not in raids). It's found nowhere else in the wild; Golden Hour and the Ranger Outfit boost it, odds events don't. A Mirage parent passes it on in the Day Care. See Special looks.
  • Gilded never turns up in the Safari.

Catching

Throw by hand with Ball, Bait and Rock, or let your Catch rules do it. Safari Balls catch by rarity: common 40%, uncommon 30%, rare 20%, legendary 5%.

  • Bait: it stays longer but is harder to catch. Rock: easier to catch, but it's more likely to run.
  • Ordinary Pokémon can run after each move: common 10%, uncommon 15%, rare 20%. Shiny, Void, Prismatic, Mirage, Spectral and Legendary finds run only 1% of the time.
  • On auto, an ordinary one gets 3 balls if a rule wants it, 2 under Catch everything. Out of balls on a find that never runs? The Professor sends 5 more.

Safari Tokens

Earned from steps, rare finds and your Safari Dex, and paid when you leave a trip. Spend them in the Safari Shop on Safari Balls, Longer Trips, Trail Mix, Scout's Focus, Costume Vouchers, Mints, Bottle Caps and cosmetics.

  • Ranger Outfit, both looks: worn on a trip it gives special looks ×1.25 and encounters ×1.25. Auto-wear puts it on when you enter and back when you leave.
  • Safari Dex: catch a species, then reveal its card for Tokens (common 10, uncommon 15, rare 20, legendary 35). A full card earns a keepsake stamp.

Safari Ladder

Your 5 best finds of the week add up to your score. Rarer species and looks are worth far more. Rewards are paid the first time you open the Safari after Monday 01:00 UTC.
